name: Insight Pre-Trade Safety API
description: Decision-input integrity for AI agents trading onchain: before a trade is signed, check whether the price it relies on is trustworthy — multi-provider oracle consensus, manipulation-risk scoring, and feed health, with verifiable EIP-712 attestations. USDC on Base.

resources.description: Pre-trade decision-input integrity check: is the price this action relies on trustworthy? Cross-provider consensus, deviation, freshness, and manipulation risk for one trade, with verifiable EIP-712 attestation support. BLOCK verdicts are complete checks and are charged.

MCP tools/call over JSON-RPC (streamable HTTP): pay-per-call access to the Insight oracle tool catalog for x402 agents without an API key. Amount shown is the C3 anchor ($0.02, e.g. pre_trade_safety_check); the live 402 quote prices each call from its tool metering class (C1=2000, C2=8000, C3=20000, C4=40000 atomic).
